comment: Fueling constants for the fuel/drop-bag cards + planner column. Edit freely — the app falls back to built-in defaults if this file is missing or invalid. Demand-driven fills: base = tailwind_flasks of mix; when a leg's fluid shortfall exceeds preload_over_flask_ml, ONE extra flask takes mix (carbs ride along), further spares (up to spare_flasks total) take plain water; smaller shortfalls are drunk at the aid before leaving. bloks_frac = share of a phase's carried units taken as Clif Bloks. drop_bag_gear = non-food items per bag ('Start' = the vest).

phases.supplement: gels lead; bloks while chewing is easy

caffeine_comment: Caffeinated-gel schedule. Doses are placed from nightfall to tail_h before the projected finish, never tighter than min_spacing_h, and snapped to aid stations where one is close — so the schedule moves with the goal time instead of being hand-written. body_kg drives every mg/kg figure and is the one number here with no other source in the repo (Strava's profile weight is stale). Set gels to 0 to plan the race caffeine-free.
